full_name: Heather Hart | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2021–2022 Arts Marilyn Beaudry-Corbett Schlesinger Fellow Rutgers University-New Brunswick
bio: Heather Hart is an interdisciplinary visual artist based in Brooklyn, New York. Her work engages form and liminality to question and redistribute power.
